author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: No longer talk at all about the kind of man that a good man ought to be, but be such.
hook: Stop talking about who you'll be.
visuals: still:ancient marble statue of a stoic philosopher, dramatic side light, black background
still:roman soldier standing alone in the rain, cinematic

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: The best way of avenging thyself is not to become like the wrong doer.
hook: Want revenge? Here's the real kind.
visuals: still:marble bust of Marcus Aurelius, dramatic chiaroscuro light
still:ancient roman emperor in armour, calm face, torchlight

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Do not act as if thou wert going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over thee.
hook: You're acting like you have forever.
visuals: still:ancient hourglass on stone, candle light, dark background
still:roman ruins at dusk, dramatic sky

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Look within. Within is the fountain of good, and it will ever bubble up, if thou wilt ever dig.
hook: What you're looking for isn't out there.
visuals: still:ancient marble statue of a stoic philosopher, dramatic side light, black background
still:lone philosopher sitting on a cliff above the sea at dawn

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Take away thy opinion, and then there is taken away the complaint, I have been harmed.
hook: Most of the hurt is in your head.
visuals: still:marble statue head cracked, dramatic light, black background

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Be like the promontory against which the waves continually break, but it stands firm and tames the fury of the water around it.
hook: Let them crash. Stand still.
visuals: still:ancient stone cliff fortress in a storm at sea, cinematic

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Confine thyself to the present.
hook: Tomorrow isn't your job right now.
visuals: still:ancient marble statue of a stoic philosopher, dramatic side light, black background

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: The universe is transformation: life is opinion.
hook: Your life is what you decide it means.
visuals: still:marble statue of a philosopher looking at the stars

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: If thou art pained by any external thing, it is not this thing that disturbs thee, but thy own judgment about it.
hook: It's not the thing. It's your take on it.
visuals: still:ancient marble statue of a stoic philosopher, dramatic side light, black background

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Such as are thy habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of thy mind; for the soul is dyed by the thoughts.
hook: You become what you replay.
visuals: still:ancient marble statue of a stoic philosopher, dramatic side light, black background

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 13, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
hook: It's probably not as bad as you think.
visuals: still:marble bust of Seneca, dramatic candlelight

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 1, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: Nothing, Lucilius, is ours, except time.
hook: You own one thing.
visuals: still:marble bust of Seneca, dramatic candlelight

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 2, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: It is not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, that is poor.
hook: Rich isn't a number.
visuals: still:ancient philosopher in a plain tunic sitting peacefully, warm light

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 7, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: Associate with those who will make a better man of you.
hook: Look at the five people around you.
visuals: still:group of ancient philosophers talking in a stone courtyard

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 2, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: Everywhere means nowhere.
hook: Pick one thing.
visuals: still:marble bust of Seneca, dramatic candlelight

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 101, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
hook: Stop waiting to start.
visuals: still:ancient roman road at dawn, cinematic

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 28, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: You need a change of soul rather than a change of climate.
hook: Moving won't fix it.
visuals: still:marble bust of Seneca, dramatic candlelight

author: Seneca
citation: Moral Letters 104, trans. Richard M. Gummere
quote: You must lay aside the burdens of the mind; until you do this, no place will satisfy you.
hook: You took it with you.
visuals: still:weary roman traveller on an ancient road at dusk

author: Epictetus
quote: Men are disturbed not by the things which happen, but by the opinions about the things.
hook: It's not what happened.
visuals: still:ancient greek philosopher with a walking stick, stone room, side light

author: Epictetus
quote: It is impossible for a man to begin to learn that which he thinks that he knows.
hook: Think you know it? You've stopped.
visuals: still:ancient greek philosopher teaching in a stone room, warm light

author: Epictetus
quote: Consider at what price you sell your own will: if for no other reason, at least for this, that you sell it not for a small sum.
hook: What's your price?
visuals: still:ancient greek philosopher, stern face, torchlight

author: Epictetus
quote: Every habit and faculty is maintained and increased by the corresponding actions.
hook: You are what you repeat.
visuals: still:ancient greek wrestlers training in a stone gymnasium

author: Epictetus
quote: It is circumstances (difficulties) which show what men are.
hook: Hard times show you who you are.
visuals: still:ancient greek wrestlers grappling, dust and sunlight
